svg.aria-label: Three ways a farmer gives a bank consent. 1, in person at the bank (built): staff raise the request in the partner portal, the farmer logs in with the national ID, signs a form that staff upload, Consent Manager staff verify it and check the Farmer ID in the Farmer Registry, the bank queries with the consent ID, and the bank admin downloads the consent record. 2, by SMS (planned): the Consent Manager texts the phone registered with the national ID and the farmer replies YES. 3, self-service (planned): the farmer logs in to a portal or app with the national ID, approves or declines, and can revoke later.
svg.text: How a farmer gives a bank consent
The consent lives in the Consent Manager, not with the bank: the farmer confirms it there (or through a channel it checks), and the bank keeps a provable copy.
the farmer is with bank staff; national-ID login + signed form + Consent Manager staff check
